info.name: Alerting API
info.description: Run with ./postman/run.sh. alertId, fingerprintMapped and fingerprintFailed come from run.sh, which puts the matching records on Kafka first. Contract: contracts/api.md.

exec: // One id suffix per run, so the collection can run again against the same database.

pm.test("4 seeded sources are there", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(s => s.id); ["workflows-kafka","trades-kafka","alertmanager-http","pricing-logs-http"].forEach(id => pm.expect(ids).to.include(id)); });

item.name: Fix the severity of the rule's alerts
Body id differs from URL id: 422
Save and mark a schema sample mapped

exec: pm.test("the failed-to-be sample is pending", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(s => s.fingerprint)).to.include(pm.variables.get("fingerprintFailed")));
pm.test("failed with the error", () => { const s = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql("failed"); pm.expect(s.error).to.eql("no valid mapping"); });

pm.test("alert and timeline", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.alert.id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("alertId")); pm.expect(d.timeline).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(d.runbook).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("acked by anna", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("acked"); pm.expect(a.acked_by).to.eql("anna"); });
pm.test("resolved by anna", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("resolved"); pm.expect(a.resolved_by).to.eql("anna"); });

item.name: File a rule_severity proposal as the ai-worker

exec: pm.test("open, authored by the ai-worker", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql("open"); pm.expect(p.author).to.eql("ai-worker"); pm.collectionVariables.set("proposalId", p.id); });

item.name: File it again: the same proposal, 200
A person accepts: the rule gets the severity

exec: pm.test("accepted by anna", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql("accepted"); pm.expect(p.decided_by).to.eql("anna"); });
